hook.head: What is an AI agent, really?
hook.vo: Everyone says AI agent. Here's what it actually means.

tips.vo: A chatbot answers one message. An agent gets a goal, like: build me a landing page, and works toward it on its own.
tips.head: It gets a goal.

msgs: Build me a landing page for my bakery
On it. I'll plan it, build it, and test it.

tips.vo: Agents use tools. They read files, run code, search, and edit, one step after another, and check the result each time.
tips.head: It uses tools.

tips.n: Step three. You stay in charge.
tips.vo: Good agents ask before big changes. You approve the plan, and you review the work before anything goes live.
tips.head: You stay in charge.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
